items.title: A property smooth local on source and target, stable under postcomposition with smooth morphisms, is smooth local on the source-and-target

items.difficulty_reason: The proof first derives stability under precomposition with smooth morphisms and under smooth base change from two cited locality lemmas, then does a genuine diagram chase: given f : X \to Y satisfying part (3)(b) of the definition, it covers X by the smooth charts U_x \to X, takes coproducts U = \coprod U_x, V = \coprod V_x, h = \coprod h_x, notes h has P because P is smooth local on the target, and descends P from b \circ h (which has P by postcomposition stability) along the surjective smooth a using smooth locality on the source. The coproduct assembly and the two descent steps are the substance.
